thread:
Tara: Who took the last chocolate bar from the snack shelf? It had my name in tiny pencil.
Owen: That was an aggressive snack move. I plead the fifth. :chocolate_bar:
Rina: I left a polite sticky note saying 'Do not eat (I had plans)'. Clearly the universe ignored it.
Tara: One-liner challenge while we debate: best one-liner about rogue snacks wins a doodle on the snack shelf.
Owen: 'Snack thieves live fast, chocolate lasts longer.'
Rina: 'Her name was Snickers. She ran out of time.'
Tara: ops-bot: inventory check?
ops-bot: Low stock alert: chocolate bars = 0, granola = 4. Please replenish if you like midday heroism.
Owen: New rule proposal: put initials on snacks or face the sticker of shame.
Rina: Vote: :white_check_mark: initials, :x: sticker of shame?
Tara: I voted initials. Also leaving a tiny marker by the shelf.
Owen: Fine. I will now write my initials on a debris of packaging to signal ownership.
Rina: Winner for one-liner is Rina. Doodle prize goes to her.
Tara: Closing line: 'If the chocolate had a manifesto, it would say: eat responsibly.' :laughing:
